excerpt: Compare buying an apartment in Aljada and Al Mamsha using the actual building, layout, ownership documents, payment schedule and total cost.
introduction:
Aljada and Al Mamsha both offer Sharjah apartment buyers a community setting, but the better purchase depends on the individual building, phase and household needs. Compare the exact unit's layout, access, operating facilities, ownership right and full cost rather than deciding from the masterplan alone.

The example costs below show a consistent method for comparing the two homes. The examples show how purchase costs can be compared using the same approach for each home.
takeaways: Inspect the exact building and distinguish completed facilities from planned phases.
Confirm the buyer's ownership eligibility and request the full payment and registration schedule.
Compare total cost, service charges, daily journeys and the apartment's condition on the same basis.

sections.heading: How do the communities compare?
sections.body:
[Arada describes Aljada](https://www.arada.com/en/aljada/) as a mixed community with residential, education, retail and leisure components. [Alef describes Al Mamsha](https://www.alefgroup.ae/alef-communities/almamsha/) as an apartment community designed around pedestrian spaces, retail and leisure. These are developer descriptions; check the status and access of the particular phase and building.

Walk the route from the apartment entrance to parking, shops and any facility you plan to use. Check whether the school, pool or other amenity is currently operating and whether it serves your building. Check which facilities are complete and available to residents of the chosen home.

The [Sharjah family area guide](/journal/best-areas-to-buy-property-in-sharjah-for-families) offers a wider shortlist if other locations may suit the household.

sections.heading: Inspect the apartment and phase
sections.body:
Check the layout, usable storage, kitchen, cooling, windows, noise and visible condition. Measure the spaces needed for furniture. Confirm the allocated parking and the route from it to the unit. If buying off-plan, compare the signed plan and specification with the sales material and ask for dated construction progress.

Review the building management, common areas, service-charge statement and any outstanding balance. Ask which shared facilities are included in the charge and how faults are reported. Two buildings in the same community may have different costs and maintenance histories.

For a ready apartment, arrange an appropriate inspection and record any agreed repairs. For an off-plan unit, check the handover, delay and specification-change provisions with a qualified adviser if necessary.

sections.heading: Compare the complete cost
sections.body:
Imagine an Aljada apartment priced at AED 850,000 with AED 40,000 of assumed acquisition costs and AED 10,000 of setup work, totalling AED 900,000. A sample Al Mamsha apartment costs AED 820,000 with AED 55,000 of assumed acquisition costs and AED 20,000 of setup, totalling AED 895,000. The example figures show how the purchase costs are organised for each home.

The chart shows these example totals before a separate contingency and ongoing charges. A lower asking price does not necessarily remain lower after the other inputs. Replace every number with a written quote for the actual unit.

The [Sharjah purchase cost guide](/journal/total-cost-of-buying-an-apartment-in-sharjah) explains the categories to include. If borrowing, compare the bank's down payment, fees, repayment schedule and insurance separately.

sections.heading: Check ownership and registration
sections.body:
Ask Sharjah's registration department to confirm the right available to your nationality for the exact unit and project. The [Sharjah ownership eligibility guide](/journal/how-to-check-foreign-ownership-eligibility-in-sharjah) explains the documents and questions. Developer marketing alone does not confirm the current legal position for every property.

Review the title or initial registration, seller or developer authority, any mortgage or tenancy and required clearance. Obtain a written quote for registration, brokerage and other transaction costs. Verify the payment recipient independently and retain receipts and registration documents.

For an off-plan purchase, review the instalment dates, specification, handover and default terms. Review the full purchase price and the dates of all remaining instalments.

sections.heading: Test the household routine and future use
sections.body:
Take the school and work routes at the times you would actually travel. Ask schools about places and transport for the exact address. Check whether the household needs a second car or paid parking and include that cost. A planned connection is not the same as a service operating today.

If the apartment is an investment, seek recent signed leases for comparable units and deduct vacancy, service charges, management and repairs. Do not treat an area-wide advertised yield as a guarantee. If it is a family home, compare storage, play space and accessibility as well as cost.

Keep a reserve and test a delay or unexpected repair. Consider whether the apartment will remain suitable if the household or work routine changes.

sections.heading: Compare payment timing
sections.body:
Put the deposit, registration, construction instalments, handover balance and any bank disbursement on a calendar. Include current rent until the new home is available. Confirm whether a reservation amount is credited towards the price and the written conditions for a refund.

A payment plan can make two prices appear similar while creating very different cash needs at handover. Compare the full schedule and retain enough liquidity for an unexpected delay or change in financing. Do not rely on an assumed future sale to meet a contractual payment.

Ask when a final service-charge budget will be available for a new building and whether the estimate is approved or preliminary. Add the anticipated annual amount to the household or investment worksheet, and update it once the actual statement is issued.

sections.heading: Request current apartment options
sections.body:
Browse [Aliyas Aljada projects](/projects?emirate=Sharjah&area=sharjah-aljada) and [Al Mamsha projects](/projects?emirate=Sharjah&area=sharjah-al-mamsha). Ask which specific units are currently available and request their plans, prices and current charges.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget, nationality and intended use. Verify the right, documents and official costs before committing.
